propwash.join.title: Add-ons don't match this server
propwash.join.intro.blocked: To join, your Propwash add-ons have to match the server's. This is what differs:
propwash.join.intro.closed: The connection was closed. Your Propwash add-ons differ from the server's – most likely that's the reason:
propwash.join.note.server_only: The server also has %s %s. Propwash doesn't need it on your side, but the server might.
propwash.join.note.client_only: Only on your side – Propwash allows that.
propwash.join.note.client_only_inactive: The server doesn't have it – Propwash lets you join anyway, %s stays inactive while you play there.
propwash.join.note.same_parts: Same parts in both versions – Propwash allows that. To match the server exactly, install %s %s.
propwash.join.action.remove: Remove %s or ask the server owner to install it.
propwash.join.action.reinstall: Reinstall %s %s – your copy has other part data than the server's (changed files?).
propwash.join.action.propwash: Install Propwash FPV %s, the server's version.
propwash.join.action.propwash_reinstall: Reinstall Propwash FPV %s – the built-in parts differ from the server's.
propwash.join.unknown.title: Unknown parts (%s)
propwash.join.unknown.inactive: Only on your side, inactive on this server: %s
propwash.join.unknown.action: No add-on on your side or on the server names these parts – ask the server owner which add-on they come from.
propwash.join.unknown.inactive_action: Propwash keeps these parts inactive while you play on this server – nothing to do.
propwash.join.session.title: Add-ons inactive on this server
propwash.join.session.message.one: %s is not installed on this server and is inactive for this session.
propwash.join.session.message: %s are not installed on this server and are inactive for this session.
propwash.join.session.unavailable_parts: Parts not available on this server: %s
propwash.join.session.blocked_item: %s is not available on this server – Propwash kept it out of your inventory.
propwash.join.session.code_parts: This code uses parts that are not available on this server: %s
propwash.join.missing_propwash: This server requires Propwash FPV %s (network protocol %s). Install exactly this version.
propwash.join.disconnect.title: Your Propwash add-ons don't match this server.
